Meta.title: WoWHelp
Meta.description: Plan your World of Warcraft sessions: pick what you want to do today, track your goals and see what data each answer comes from.

Footer.disclaimer: WoWHelp is a fan-made tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.
Footer.status: Early preview. Features arrive in phases and each page says what is ready.
Footer.credits: Logo and illustrations by Elianai dos Santos (eliz00r).

Home.metaTitle: What do you want to do today?
Home.heading: What do you want to do today?
Home.intro: Choose what you want from the game right now. WoWHelp turns it into goals and short steps you can follow on any screen, and tells you where each piece of data comes from.
Home.pickerLabel: Choose up to eight things you want to do
Home.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing chosen yet} one {# chosen} other {# chosen}}
Home.trackerEmpty: Choose something on the left and it shows up here, like a quest you just accepted.
Home.trackerEmptyMobile: Choose something above and it shows up here.

howSteps.choose: Choose what you want to do. You can change it whenever you like.
howSteps.connect: Bring in your characters: Battle.net linking and the Companion addon import arrive in later phases.
howSteps.plan: Follow goals and checklists made for the time you have.

Home.sourcesIntro: Every status on WoWHelp shows its source and when it was last checked. When we don't know something, we say so instead of guessing.

battlenet.title: Battle.net
battlenet.body: Characters and collections from Blizzard's official API, only with your permission.

manual.title: You
manual.body: Goals, checklists and progress you mark yourself. Always labeled as entered by you.

Characters.title: Characters
Characters.intro: Link your Battle.net account to bring in your characters and your mount collection. WoWHelp reads only what you authorize and never sees your password.
Characters.retention: Data from Battle.net is deleted automatically if it is not refreshed within 30 days, and right away when you disconnect.
Characters.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this region and delete the characters and collection that came from Battle.net? Your goals stay.
Characters.consent: You will be sent to Battle.net to approve access to your World of Warcraft characters and collections. Syncing again asks for approval again, because WoWHelp does not keep your Battle.net access.
Characters.notConfigured: Battle.net linking is not available in this environment yet.
Characters.mountsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No mounts found in the collection} one {# mount collected} other {# mounts collected}}
Characters.empty: No characters yet. Connect Battle.net to bring them in.
Characters.emptyRegion: No characters found in this region.

Import.title: Import from the addon
Import.intro: Rather not connect Battle.net? The WoWHelp Companion addon saves your characters and mount collection on your computer, and you upload the file here.
Import.step1Body: Extract the zip into this folder:
Import.downloadNote: For World of Warcraft Retail (Midnight, interface {interface}). No internet access and no combat data.
Import.step2Body: The addon reads your data when you log in and when you earn a mount. Type /wowhelp to see the last read.
Import.step3Body: The game only writes the file to your computer when you log out or reload the UI.

Import.deleteBody: Removes the characters, collection and history that came from the addon. Battle.net data and your own marks stay.
Import.privacy: The file is read on our server without running anything and discarded right after. We keep only characters, collected mounts and a summary of each import, until you delete them here or delete your account.

Account.dataBody: Download a copy of everything WoWHelp keeps about you (profile, goals, planner, characters, collection and addon imports) as a JSON file.
Account.deleteBody: Deletes the account and all of its data right away: goals, planner, Battle.net connections, characters, collection and addon imports. This cannot be undone.
Account.deleteLabel: To confirm, type the account email

Admin.title: Curation
Admin.intro: Fill in what Blizzard's API doesn't have. Nothing shows on the site before you publish, and drop chance needs a source.
Admin.mountsBody: Drop chance, where to get it, step by step and source.
Admin.viewPublic: See it as the public does
Admin.settingsBody: Your account is a curator: you publish drop chance, location and steps for mounts.

guide.dropChanceHint: E.g. 1 or 0.5. Leave empty if unknown.
guide.noteHint: E.g. per boss, per character, once a week.
guide.sourceHint: Required when there is a drop chance. Prefer an official source.
guide.encounterHint: Optional. Used later to count your attempts through Battle.net.

saved.approve: Published. It now shows on the site.
saved.draft: Draft saved. It doesn't show on the site yet.
saved.unpublish: Unpublished. It left the site and became a draft.

Admin.siteBody: Close the site with a password during testing, or open it to the public.

site.title: Private site
site.intro: With a private site, anyone needs the password to see any page. Use it during testing and turn it off at launch (Google AdSense does not approve closed sites).
site.privateHint: Asks for the password on every page. Anyone who typed it keeps access for 30 days, until you change the password.
site.keepHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. Changing it removes everyone's access.
site.savedPrivate: Saved: the site is private. This browser already has access. It can take up to 30 seconds to apply everywhere.
site.savedPublic: Saved: the site is open to the public. It can take up to 30 seconds to apply everywhere.
site.note: The password is stored only as a scrambled code (hash); nobody can read it from the database.

request.title: Join the Brazilian community
request.intro: Do you stream, make videos or other World of Warcraft content in Portuguese? Send your channels. The WoWHelp team reviews every request.
request.rule1: WoW content in Portuguese, on a regular basis.
request.rule2: Respect for the community: no hate, scams or inappropriate content.
request.rule3: Nobody pays to join or to be featured.
request.displayName: Channel name or how people know you
request.linksHint: One per line: Twitch, YouTube or Kick.
request.message: Tell us a bit about your content (optional)
request.privacy: We keep the request for the team to review. Published channels only show what is already public on each platform.

request.signIn: To prevent spam, you need to sign in with a WoWHelp account to send the request.
